newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Inkombank sees ADR price at about $0.80.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Inkombank sees ADR price at about $0.80.

text.p: AB Inkombank, which plans to sell nine million ordinary shares through an issue of level one American Depositary Receipts soon, hopes to get about $0.80 per 1,000 rouble share, a bank spokesman said on Thursday.
"We hope the price will be close to $0.80 and maybe we'll get a small premium," the spokesman told Reuters.
The placement will be a public one with possibly a small portion allocated for a private placement, he said.
The bank did not chose a lead manager for the project, he said.
The first deal with Inkombank's ADRs will take place at the beginning of next week.
Bank of New York is Inkombank's depositor and ING-Bank Euroasia will be the custodian.
Inkombank plans to issue level-two and level-three ADRs, which unlike level-one receipts raise new capital, in 1997 or 1998.

Last month Inkombank, Bank Menatep and Bank Vozrozhdeniye received permission from Russia's central bank to sell their shares to foreigners. Russian banks cannot sell their shares to foreigners without central bank permission for each deal.
Bank shares are not actively traded in Russia.
